# ADR-3203: AWS iam: IAM Access Analyzer required key for account 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

External access findings need continuous detection.

## Decision

Account baselines SHALL include an IAM Access Analyzer required key for account 3 (AWS-iam-3).

## Consequences

Analyzer findings page security owners.
